# Black-box sandbagging detection on Cedar: dashboard

Static dashboard of black-box sandbagging detection experiments on UK AISI's Cedar model organism
("Auditing Games for Sandbagging", arXiv:2512.07810), compared with honest models of similar accuracy:
results overview, panel plots, per-method tables and sample transcripts.

Published with GitHub Pages from the root of the `main` branch of this repository. This repository contains
**only the built site**, generated by the project's private code repository and force-pushed as a single commit
(each page names the source commit and build date). Do not edit it by hand. See `NOTICE.md` for third-party notices.
